name: Sylvian
source:
A captivating swan descendant, and Lars's potential love interest. 
A genius in the art of flower magic, his past lies shrouded in the corridors of academia. 

His demeanor is serene, much like the gentle caress of the wind. He navigates life with tranquility, often refraining from disturbing his current peace. This peaceful existence, however, conceals a bittersweet truth - a one-sided love affair that tugs at his heart.

[From [url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/love-amidst-the-timeless-rift]official profile[/url]]
